reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 both MOD arguments must be integers per §1989:A.2.2 AR4 (always-integral arithmetic expressions; numeric functions barred by §1989:A.2.3 GR2): the compiler must accept integer literals, unscaled items, integer functions and always-integral expressions in either position, and refuse a non-integral literal, a scaled item, a numeric function, a non-numeric operand or a not-always-integral expression in either position.

reader.edition-search: As for FACTORIAL: read Violation / IntegerViolation / CheckArgumentClasses / BindFunctionResult and grepped the intrinsic binder, catalog, carrier rules and renderer for Edition|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior|ConstructRegistry|.Year.
